title: AuditEvent
description: One immutable event in the hash-chained append-only journal.

causal_parent.description: Safe causal link to the effect or prior event that caused this event.

hash.description: SHA-256 over all event fields and the previous hash.

previous_hash.description: Previous event hash, or the fixed genesis hash for sequence one.

transaction_id.description: Transaction binding, absent only for journal-wide maintenance events.

AuditEventId.description: Stable identifier for a `AuditEventId` domain object.

TransactionId.description: Stable identifier for a `TransactionId` domain object.
